Recorded claim:
`loadCalendarEventSource(identity)`, a session-keyed source cache/Redux slice, and `loadCalendarEventSnapshot({ sessionKey, identity })` keep raw `calIEvent` objects outside Redux. `CalendarEventDialogSourceMixin` owns route observation, stale-generation/request handling, cancellation, source cleanup, controlled errors, and readiness-before-show; consumers provide presentation hooks.
